summary: Examples of strftime for date, time, using the ansible_date_time.epoch fact, epoch 0, and a given epoch in UTC.
questions: How do I format ansible_date_time.epoch as a date?
How do I print the date for epoch 1441357287 in UTC?
How do I show hours, minutes and seconds?

answer_card.title: strftime examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ '%Y-%m-%d' | strftime }}                          # 2021-03-19
{{ '%H:%M:%S' | strftime }}                          # 21:51:04
{{ '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' | strftime(ansible_date_time.epoch) }}
{{ '%Y-%m-%d' | strftime(0) }}                       # 1970-01-01
{{ '%Y-%m-%d' | strftime(seconds=1441357287, utc=true) }}  # 2015-09-04
```
